title: 第2章 牛逼的军官证！
content_zh:
不过，为首的高个男人却眉头一皱，阻止了下来，转而看向叶乘风，阴森森道：“阁下是什么人？”

矮胖男人的体重和身手，他一清二楚。

但叶乘风坐着不好施展力气的情况下，却依旧轻松一脚就把矮胖男人给踹出去老远，根本连躲闪的机会都没有。

这等爆发力，这等速度，普通平民根本就做不到。

即便是普通军人，甚至是一般的特种兵，也没有可能。

叶乘风对周围那黑洞洞的枪口，压根儿就好像没有瞧见似的，很快笑眯眯地凑到冰山美女的白嫩脸颊，如蜻蜓点水般轻吻了一口。

跟着，他又在冰山美女柳眉倒竖，脸颊发红的时刻，抚摸着冰山美女的柔顺秀发，涤荡出一阵诱人的发香，似在安抚，又似在警告冰山美女配合。

做完这一切，叶乘风才对那为首男人道：“看清楚了吗？我是这位女士的老公！”

为首的高个男人险些岔气，不由瞪眼道：“我是问，你什么身份！什么职业！”

叶乘风唇角微翘，忍不住重复了一句：“我的身份和职业，就是这位女士的老公。”

这话一出，那冰山美女与周围乘客是一阵无语，一时间都不知道该哭还是该笑。

除了说叶乘风胆气过人之外，他们还能说啥呢？

“绑起来！待会儿谈判的第一个人质，就用他！一旦谈判不和，立即杀他警告。”

为首男人此刻，哪能不知道叶乘风是纯粹消遣他的？于是铁拳捏得劈啪作响。

叶乘风眯了眯眼，声音中透着一股令人心底发寒的冷意：“刚才你们没有经过我的允许，随意改变飞机航线，影响我的行程，还没有跟你们算账。”

之前那被踹的矮胖男人，一脸不屑，看着叶乘风就好像看着一个死人。

而其他的蒙面男人，也同样不屑万分。

他们整整九个人在，人手一把微型手枪。

反观叶乘风，却只有空手一人，他是从哪里来的底气，敢如此大胆地反过来找他们麻烦？

“今天算你们运气不错，死罪可免。”

叶乘风眼中杀意一闪，只下一瞬间，他就诡异地消失在座位。

身为修真者，叶乘风在国外闯荡这十年来，见惯了杀戮，同时在他手中死去的敌人，没有一万也有八千。

面对****，他从来不会手软分毫。

但如今在飞机上，众目睽睽之下，叶乘风却不想将那血腥的杀戮场景，如此粗暴地呈现在一群普通人的面前。

就在叶乘风一个隐身法术的情况之下，九名真理教成员，可谓全体盯着那已经空无一人的座位目瞪口呆，手心不自觉地冒出了冷汗。

一声奇怪的闷哼响起，赫然是那意图强占冰山美女的矮胖男人，白眼一翻地软到在地。

但看在其余八人的眼中，却犹如见鬼。

因为他们看不见叶乘风，只能看见矮胖男人如同遭受重击一般地突然晕死在地，是那样的毫无征兆。

几声闷响之下，其余八人先后被放倒在地，根本连开枪的机会都没有。

做完这一切，叶乘风的身形才慢慢显露出来，可谓惊呆了那冰山美女，也惊呆了全机舱的所有客人和空姐。

不过，叶乘风却只留给了他们一道潇洒背影，便是朝着驾驶舱行去。

在那里，还有三名蒙脸的真理教男子没有处理。

当叶乘风走进驾驶舱的时候，那余下的三名真理教成员，居然当着机长的面，在分着香烟。

“妈的，你们不想活，老子还想呢！”

叶乘风闪身过去，手刀如电，几下子便把那最后的三名真理教成员，给打晕了在地，惹得那机长是目瞪口呆，心中暗呼恐怖。

如果不是亲眼所见，这是一次真的不能再真的劫机，他甚至以为是在拍戏。

这年轻人的手刀，就这么轻轻挥了几下，三名身强体壮的大汉就晕了过去，未免太不可思议了吧？

叶乘风轻轻拍了拍机长的肩膀，随便找了个座位坐下，并不想回机舱去了。

至于二来，则是他不想再与那些普通乘客碰面了，免得被当成怪物。

机长是没见到叶乘风那突然隐身的诡异情况，所以并不害怕。

相反，机长还激动得有些舌头打结，忙透过通讯器与机上的空警联系，将驾驶舱的情况简单说了一通。

随后，那名之前被打得头破血流的空警，便用一块毛巾捂着流血的伤口，踉跄地行来。

“你好，我是随机飞行的空警，名叫杨国东。”

空警亮了亮证件，十分热情地握着叶乘风的手道：“非常感谢先生的见义勇为！这次要不是您的帮助，后果可真是不堪设想啊！我代表航空公司，代表全机组工作人员，以及机上所有乘客，真诚地感谢您。”

叶乘风颇显无奈地耸了耸肩，很快伸手在裤兜里掏出了五六本证件。

于是，他随手拿了一个，就递了出去，又把余下的随便塞回裤兜。

杨国东接过一看，顿时手一抖，差点给跪了。

而且，证件上所罗列出来的一系列职务和头衔，简直牛逼得不像话，险些把杨国东给吓尿了。

要不是杨国东确信，这是货真价实的军官证，恐怕都不敢置信这样一个年轻人会有如此恐怖的职务和头衔！

几乎是下一瞬间，杨国东便把证件还给了叶乘风。

跟着，杨国东又恭恭敬敬地行了个军礼，哆嗦着用那只有他和叶乘风能听见的音量道：“首……首长，我……我保证不会泄漏您的身份。”
content_en:
However, the tall man at the head frowned, stopped, turned to look at Ye Chengfeng, and said grimly: "Who are you?"

He knew clearly the weight and agility of the short, fat man.

But when Ye Chengfeng was sitting and unable to exert his strength, he still easily kicked the short and fat man far away without even a chance to dodge.

Ordinary civilians simply cannot achieve this level of explosive power and speed.

Even for ordinary soldiers or even ordinary special forces, it is impossible.

Ye Chengfeng didn't seem to notice the dark muzzles around him at all. He quickly smiled and leaned towards the white and tender cheek of the iceberg beauty, and kissed her gently like a dragonfly touching water.

Then, when the iceberg beauty's eyebrows stood up and her cheeks turned red, he stroked the iceberg beauty's silky hair, exhaling a burst of alluring fragrance, which seemed to comfort and warn the iceberg beauty to cooperate.

After doing all this, Ye Chengfeng said to the leading man: "Do you see clearly? I am this lady's husband!"

The tall man at the head almost lost his temper and couldn't help but glared: "I'm asking, what is your identity! What is your occupation!"

Ye Chengfeng's lips curled up slightly, and he couldn't help but repeat: "My identity and profession are this lady's husband."

As soon as these words came out, the iceberg beauty and the passengers around her were speechless for a while. They didn't know whether to cry or laugh.

Apart from saying that Ye Chengfeng was extremely courageous, what else could they say?

"Tie him up! Use him as the first hostage in the negotiation later! If the negotiation fails, kill him immediately as a warning."

At this moment, how could the leading man not know that Ye Chengfeng was purely entertaining him?So the iron fist crackled loudly.

Ye Chengfeng narrowed his eyes, and there was a chilling chill in his voice: "You just changed the flight route at will without my permission, affecting my schedule, and I haven't settled the accounts with you yet."

The short, fat man who was kicked before had a look of disdain on his face and looked at Ye Chengfeng as if he were looking at a dead person.

The other masked men were equally disdainful.

There were nine of them, each armed with a miniature pistol.

On the other hand, Ye Chengfeng was left empty-handed. Where did he get the confidence to be so bold and come to trouble them?

"You are lucky today and can avoid the death penalty."

Ye Chengfeng's eyes flashed with murderous intent, and in just a split second, he mysteriously disappeared from his seat.

As a cultivator, Ye Chengfeng has been living abroad for the past ten years and has become accustomed to killings. At the same time, not only 10,000 but also 8,000 enemies died in his hands.

He will never show any mercy in the face of violence.

But now on the plane, in full view of everyone, Ye Chengfeng did not want to show the bloody killing scene so crudely in front of a group of ordinary people.

Under Ye Chengfeng's invisibility spell, the nine members of the Truth Cult all stared at the empty seats with their mouths agape, and cold sweat broke out on their palms unconsciously.

There was a strange muffled groan, and it was the short, fat man who wanted to seize the iceberg beauty. He rolled his eyes and fell to the ground.

But in the eyes of the other eight people, it was like seeing a ghost.

Because they couldn't see Ye Chengfeng, they could only see the short, fat man suddenly fainted and died on the ground as if he had been hit hard, without any warning.

With a few muffled sounds, the other eight people were put down to the ground one after another, without even a chance to shoot.

After doing all this, Ye Chengfeng's figure was slowly revealed. It can be said that the iceberg beauty was shocked, as well as all the guests and flight attendants in the cabin.

However, Ye Chengfeng only left them with a graceful figure as he walked towards the cockpit.

There, there were still three Shinrikyo men with their faces covered who were not dealt with.

When Ye Chengfeng walked into the cockpit, the remaining three members of the Truth Cult were actually sharing cigarettes in front of the captain.

"Damn it, you don't want to live, but I still want to!"

Ye Chengfeng dodged over, with the knife in his hand like lightning, and knocked the last three members of the Truth Cult unconscious to the ground in a few strokes, leaving the captain dumbfounded and secretly screaming in terror.

If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, this would have been a real hijacking. He even thought it was filming.

This young man's hand knife was swung a few times, and three strong men fainted. Isn't it incredible?

Ye Chengfeng gently patted the captain's shoulder and found a seat to sit down casually, not wanting to go back to the cabin.

Secondly, he didn't want to meet ordinary passengers anymore, lest he be regarded as a monster.

The captain had not seen the strange situation of Ye Chengfeng suddenly becoming invisible, so he was not afraid.

On the contrary, the captain was so excited that he was tongue-tied and hurriedly contacted the air police on the plane through the communicator and briefly explained the situation in the cockpit.

Then, the air marshal who had been beaten to a bloody head covered the bleeding wound with a towel and staggered over.

"Hello, I am an air marshal flying randomly. My name is Yang Guodong."

The air marshal showed his ID card, held Ye Chengfeng's hand enthusiastically and said, "Thank you very much, sir, for your bravery! If it weren't for your help this time, the consequences would have been unimaginable! On behalf of the airline, the entire crew, and all the passengers on the plane, I sincerely thank you."

Ye Chengfeng shrugged helplessly, and quickly reached into his trouser pocket and took out five or six certificates.

So, he took one casually, handed it out, and stuffed the rest back into his trouser pocket.

Yang Guodong took it and took a look. His hands shook and he almost knelt down.

Moreover, the series of positions and titles listed on the certificate were so awesome that they almost scared Yang Guodong to the point of peeing.

If Yang Guodong hadn't been convinced that this was a genuine military officer's certificate, he might not have believed that such a young man had such a terrifying position and title!

Almost immediately, Yang Guodong returned the certificate to Ye Chengfeng.

Then, Yang Guodong respectfully performed a military salute and said in a trembling voice that only he and Ye Chengfeng could hear: "Chief... Chief, I... I promise not to reveal your identity."
